description: This file defines the PdfSignatureHandler class responsible for managing digital signatures in PDF documents within the PdfSharp library. It includes methods to create signatures, compute signature ranges, and add signature-related PDF objects and fields.

classes.name: DigitalSignatureHandler
classes.description: Handles the attachment of PKCS#7 signatures to PdfDocument, manages signature creation, range computation, and PDF object management related to digital signatures.

methods.name: ForDocument
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a singleton instance of DigitalSignatureHandler for a specific PdfDocument.

methods.name: ComputeSignatureAndRange
methods.description: Computes the digital signature and updates the byte range in the PDF stream.

methods.name: FormatHex
methods.description: Converts a byte array into a hexadecimal string, used for encoding signatures.

methods.name: GetRangeToSignAndByteRangeArray
methods.description: Calculates the byte ranges of the document to be signed, excluding the placeholder signature.

methods.name: AddSignatureComponentsAsync
methods.description: Adds the necessary PDF objects and fields to prepare the document for a digital signature.

methods.name: GetSignatureField
methods.description: Creates a PDF signature field with the specified signature dictionary.

methods.name: GetSignatureDictionary
methods.description: Constructs the signature dictionary object with signature properties and placeholders.
